articles.title: Magnetoelectric antennas could transform how underwater robots talk
articles.summary: A groundbreaking new antenna technology, inspired by the physics of medical implants, aims to revolutionize communication for underwater robots and submarine machines. Currently, these devices often lose contact upon descent. This innovation promises to enable reliable surface communication, enhancing operational capabilities for various sub-surface applications, potentially impacting defence, research, and exploration significantly. It tackles a major hurdle in underwater autonomy.
